## PRQA 01 · GitHub Webhook Receiver
Receives `pull_request` events, verifies the HMAC signature over the raw body, accepts `labeled` with the opt-in label (`PRQA_TRIGGER_LABEL`, default `to be test`) or `qa-test:*` on open non-draft PRs, cancels active jobs on `unlabeled` / `closed` / `synchronize`, dedupes by `X-GitHub-Delivery`, responds fast (202) and starts the Main Pipeline asynchronously.

Paths: `POST /webhook/prqa/github` (GitHub) · `POST /webhook/prqa/actions` (GitHub Actions, see below)

## 🔒 Phase 1 — REVIEW ONLY
`AUTOMATION_MODE=review_only` (compose/.env). The worker returns **mock** endpoints for GitHub, the prompt LLM and Discord, rejects every non-synthetic job with `REVIEW_ONLY_MODE`, and the registry has **0 enabled repositories**.

Nothing in this workflow can reach a real repository, API or channel until Phase 2 is explicitly approved.

parameters.content:
## GitHub Actions entry — `POST /webhook/prqa/actions`
Called by the copy-paste workflow `.github/workflows/prqa.yml`. Headers `X-PRQA-Timestamp` + `X-PRQA-Signature` (HMAC-SHA256 over `<timestamp>.<raw body>` with `PRQA_WEBHOOK_SECRET`). The **worker** verifies the signature in constant time, enforces the ±300 s window, validates the payload, derives the idempotency key `gha:<repo>#<pr>@<sha>:<level>` and claims it (replay protection), rate-limits, and returns the `job_seed`. HTTP 202 means *accepted*, never *passed*: the result arrives on Discord after the job and validation complete.
